reason: Checked against src/render.6502 and build/strykers.lst. Same branch outcome: STA zp leaves N alone, so BPL not taken iff BMI was taken. Hot path 8 -> 6 cycles (BMI 2 + STA 3 + BRA 3 -> STA 3 + BPL taken 3): BPL at &96B4 ends &96B6, group &9670, same page, offset -&46 in range. Wrap path 11 -> 13 (+2, 0.77 a pass). Final edge_screen_address_high identical on both paths (wrap: the second STA overwrites the transient &80-&82). &86 is aliased only by projectile_slot, a game-logic name. The only reads of edge_screen_address_high are game.6502 set_edge code, render.6502 header and write_column, and none is reached inside this loop. irq1_handler (sfx_tick, keyboard) and the title handler touch no &85/&86, so nothing can see the transient. Flags are dead at group (LDY #0 first); A is not used after the store; X, Y, C unchanged. No generated source, protected line, data table or raster-timed wait is involved, and no ROMSEL, ANDY or ACCCON dependence (zero page STA only). Code shrinks 2 bytes (6 -> 4) and SKIP 2 after RTS keeps hist_dst_hi at &96BF (SKIP after RTS is used the same way in game.6502), so no later address moves. Behaviour on front end, helicopter, game over and completion paths is unchanged because the same hi value is stored on every path.
